properties.description: Loading a detail view, particularly Check details while selecting repository roots, currently blocks selection/view changes. Make loading asynchronous and cancellable. Immediately accept a new selection or view choice, cancel obsolete work where supported, and prevent late results from restoring the previous selection or view. Preserve unsaved-edit handling. Reproduce delayed loading and rapid repository/view switches in a persistent exact browser recording.
properties.title: Keep repository selection and view switching responsive during loading
